overview: TradeNest Naturals produces dehydrated holy basil powder sourced directly from trusted Indian farms. Our gentle shade-drying and precision milling protect the natural aromatic profile and vibrant color of the botanicals. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain rigorous processing hygiene to supply uniform, finely milled botanical ingredients for business formulations across international supply chains.

Every batch undergoes our disciplined six-step production process, from sorting to quality inspection and final packaging. With an 80-100 mesh size and low moisture levels, our holy basil powder blends smoothly into commercial manufacturing applications. We support global importers and brands through scalable bulk supply, comprehensive export documentation, custom packaging, and flexible private-label solutions.
highlights: Originating from carefully selected Indian botanical farms
Processed via gentle dehydration and controlled milling
Fine particle size calibrated to 80-100 mesh
Moisture content controlled to 8 percent or less
Extended commercial shelf life of 24 months
Standard minimum order quantity starting at 5 Kg
applications: Herbal tea blends and hot infusions
Herbal dry blends and botanical seasonings

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for holy basil powder?
faqs.a: Our standard minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg to accommodate both trial batches and large-scale bulk orders.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk and retail buyers?
faqs.a: We provide bulk packaging in 25 kg bags and HDPE containers, intermediate 5-10 kg bags, and private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and OEM manufacturing services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full OEM and private-label contract manufacturing, including custom packaging, sizing, and brand labeling.

faqs.q: Can buyers request custom mesh sizes for specific formulations?
faqs.a: Yes, while our standard is 80-100 mesh, we can customize the mesh size and granulation according to your technical requirements.

faqs.q: Are product samples available prior to placing a bulk purchase?
faqs.a: We provide commercial product samples on request to allow technical evaluation and recipe testing before order confirmation.

faqs.q: What export compliance and shipping support do you provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete export documentation support and prepare shipments to safeguard products during transit.
